senses.def: Various characters in Greek mythology. See Wikipedia.

(Greek mythology) the daughter of Clytemnestra and Agamemnon; Agamemnon was obliged to offer her as a sacrifice to Artemis when the Greek fleet was becalmed on its way to Troy; Artemis rescued her and she later became a priestess
The daughter of Agamemnon and Clytaemnestra, who is sacrificed by her father to ensure the safe journey of the Greeks to Troy.
A Thessalian princess, the daughter of Triopas of Thessaly (a son of Poseidon and Canace).

The daughter of Ligdus and Telethusa, who, as recounted in Ovid's Metamorphoses, was raised as male and was eventually transformed into a man by the goddess Isis in order to marry Ianthe, daughter of Telestes.
A (female) native of Skyros, captured by Achilles and given to his companion-in-arms, Patroclus, as slave, as recounted in the Iliad.
A (male) Cypriot shepherd who, as recounted in Ovid's Metamorphoses, loved a woman named Anaxarete, whose indifference led him to kill himself in despair.
One of the Argonauts, the son of Sthenelus and brother of Eurystheus; also called Iphitos or Iphitus,
a smartphone designed and marketed by Apple Inc.
A smartphone of a series produced by Apple, which typically combine a camera phone, PDA, multimedia player, and wireless communication device.
ex: His mom bought him an IPhone for his 11th birthday.

senses.def: Any knockoff or similar high-end smartphone; through trademark genericization.
A face that is inappropriate for a period drama.
The moment when a company or industry realizes that it needs to catch up with apparent technological and scientific developments made by some other company or industry.
The use of an iPhone to take photographs.
